leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript interface to define the structure of a tree node with typed properties
Implement a class that enforces the tree node interface with proper type annotations
Initialize tree node instances with typed data values and nested children arrays
Manipulate the tree structure by adding and removing child nodes with type safety
Configure recursive methods to traverse the typed tree structure
Apply generic types to create reusable tree node structures for different data types
Integrate type guards to validate node properties during tree operations
